name: Barbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell overhand against your thighs with knees straight yet softly unlocked.
Set your shoulder blades back, engage your lats, and brace your core tightly.
Hinge forward from your hips to lower the bar closely down the fronts of your legs until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to drive your hips forward and stand tall.
tips: Keep your slight knee bend steady and stop lowering before your lower back rounds.
Keep the bar close to your shins rather than letting it drift forward away from your legs.
